tools.name: __awareness_workflow__
tools.description:
Call this when you're unsure what to do next with Awareness memory tools.

    Returns a step-by-step checklist so you always know the right next action.
    Low-cost call — use it anytime you need a reminder of the workflow.

tools.name: awareness_init
tools.description:
Start here — call ONCE at the beginning of every session to load your persistent memory.

    WHY: Without this call, you have no memory of past sessions. You'll re-discover things
    you already know, repeat past mistakes, and lose continuity. This is not optional.

    RETURNS:
      - session_id

tools.description:

tools.name: awareness_lookup
tools.description:

tools.name: awareness_mark_skill_used
tools.description:
Mark a skill as used and report the outcome.

    Call this AFTER applying a skill's instructions during a task.
    Outcome feedback closes the learning loop:
    - "success" (default): full decay reset, confidence boost
    - "partial": partial decay boost, no confidence change
    - "failed": dec

tools.name: awareness_apply_skill
tools.description:
Apply a learned skill — returns structured step-by-step execution plan.

    Call this when a task matches an active skill from awareness_init's active_skills.
    Returns the skill's methods, summary, and context-adapted guidance.
    Automatically marks the skill as used (resets decay timer).

tools.name: awareness_facts
tools.description:
Read bi-temporal facts from the knowledge graph.

    Default: active facts only (`valid_to IS NULL`). Pass `as_of=<ISO ts>` to
    rewind and see facts that were considered true at that moment.

    Args:
        subject_id: Filter by subject entity id.
        predicate: Filter by exact predicate

tools.name: awareness_related
tools.description:
Find related entities via n-hop graph traversal.

    Args:
        entity_id: Source entity id.
        max_hops: Traversal depth 1-4 (default 2).
        limit: Max neighbors (1-200).
        memory_id: Target memory id (auto-resolved if omitted).
        api_key: Bearer token for authentication.

tools.name: awareness_timeline
tools.description:
Bi-temporal fact stream for one entity (active + superseded).

    Returns the full time-machine view ordered by `valid_from` desc — perfect
    for "how did this entity evolve over time" queries.

    Args:
        entity_id: Entity id to scope the timeline to.
        predicate: Optional predicate

tools.name: awareness_agent_detail

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: awareness_init, awareness_record, awareness_search_knowledge, awareness_find_deals, awareness_publish_deal, awareness_find_agents, awareness_agent_detail · Private data: awareness_init, awareness_get_agent_prompt, awareness_recall, awareness_lookup, awareness_record, awareness_mark_skill_used, awareness_apply_skill, awareness_facts, awareness_related, awareness_timeline, awareness_search_knowledge, awareness_find_deals, awareness_publish_deal, awareness_find_agents, awareness_agent_detail, awareness_chat_agent, awareness_hire_agent, awareness_run_agent_task · Public sink: awareness_search_knowledge, awareness_find_deals, awareness_publish_deal · Destructive: awareness_mark_skill_used, awareness_run_agent_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: awareness_init, awareness_record, awareness_search_knowledge, awareness_find_deals, awareness_publish_deal, awareness_find_agents, awareness_agent_detail · Private data: awareness_init, awareness_get_agent_prompt, awareness_recall, awareness_lookup, awareness_record, awareness_mark_skill_used, awareness_apply_skill, awareness_facts, awareness_related, awareness_timeline, awareness_search_knowledge, awareness_find_deals, awareness_publish_deal, awareness_find_agents, awareness_agent_detail, awareness_chat_agent, awareness_hire_agent, awareness_run_agent_task · Public sink: awareness_search_knowledge, awareness_find_deals, awareness_publish_deal · Destructive: awareness_mark_skill_used, awareness_run_agent_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
